nodes.title: Natural Sciences and Technology
nodes.description: Grade 5 Natural Sciences and Technology

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Grade 5 Natural Sciences and Technology Term 1

nodes.title: Life and Living: Plants, Animals and Their Habitats
nodes.description: Describe different biomes and their characteristic plants and animals. Explain how organisms are adapted to their specific habitats.

nodes.title: Matter and Materials: Metals and Non-Metals
nodes.description: Distinguish between metals and non-metals based on physical properties: lustre, malleability, conductivity and density. Classify common materials as metals or non-metals.

nodes.title: Energy and Change: Stored Energy in Fuels
nodes.description: Describe how fuels store chemical energy. Investigate the release of energy during combustion. Identify common fuels and their uses.

nodes.title: Planet Earth and Beyond: Earth's Rotation and Orbit
nodes.description: Explain Earth's rotation on its axis causes day and night. Describe Earth's orbit around the Sun and how it causes the seasons.

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task
nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — Test or Assignment.

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Grade 5 Natural Sciences and Technology Term 2

nodes.title: Life and Living: Animal Skeletons
nodes.description: Compare vertebrate and invertebrate animals. Describe functions of skeletal systems: support, protection and movement. Identify types of skeletons: endoskeleton, exoskeleton and hydrostatic skeleton.

nodes.title: Technology: Skeletons as Structures
nodes.description: Investigate how skeletal structures support loads. Design and make a structure that uses a skeleton framework. Test and evaluate the strength of the structure.

nodes.title: Matter and Materials: Uses of Metals
nodes.description: Describe the uses of metals based on their properties: iron/steel, aluminium, copper and gold. Explain why specific metals are used for specific purposes.

nodes.title: Energy and Change: Energy and Electricity
nodes.description: Describe how electrical energy is produced and used. Investigate simple electrical circuits. Identify conductors and insulators.

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task
nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — Test or Assignment.

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Grade 5 Natural Sciences and Technology Term 3

nodes.title: Life and Living: Food Chains
nodes.description: Describe food chains and food webs. Identify producers, consumers and decomposers. Explain energy flow through food chains.

nodes.title: Life and Living: Life Cycles
nodes.description: Describe life cycles of animals: amphibians (frogs), insects (butterflies/beetles) and mammals. Compare complete and incomplete metamorphosis.

nodes.title: Matter and Materials: Processing Materials
nodes.description: Describe how natural materials are processed to make useful products. Investigate processing of materials: wood to paper, cotton to cloth, iron ore to steel.

nodes.title: Energy and Change: Energy and Movement — Elastic
nodes.description: Investigate how elastic materials store and release energy. Design and make a device that uses elastic energy to perform work.

nodes.title: Planet Earth and Beyond: Surface of Earth and Soil Types
nodes.description: Describe the surface features of Earth. Investigate different types of soil: clay, sand, silt and loam. Describe soil formation and properties.

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task
nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — Test or Assignment.

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Grade 5 Natural Sciences and Technology Term 4

nodes.title: Matter and Materials: Processed Materials
nodes.description: Investigate properties of processed materials: glass, plastics, ceramics and composites. Describe the advantages and disadvantages of different processed materials.

nodes.title: Planet Earth and Beyond: Sedimentary Rocks
nodes.description: Describe the formation of sedimentary rocks through deposition, compaction and cementation. Identify common sedimentary rocks and their characteristics.

nodes.title: Planet Earth and Beyond: Fossils
nodes.description: Describe how fossils are formed. Explain what fossils tell us about ancient life on Earth. Identify examples of important South African fossils.

nodes.title: Revision and Consolidation
nodes.description: Revision and consolidation of all Grade 5 Natural Sciences and Technology content.

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task
nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — End-of-year Test.
